qa_pair.question: Which read-only MCP tool must be called immediately before publishing a live Babylon scene or node selection as FBX?
Which external application performs the portable binary FBX conversion?
Which intermediate format binds the exact live Babylon scene snapshot before FBX conversion?
Which digest algorithm leases the live snapshot, scope, settings, destination, and published FBX evidence?
What happens if the live scene changes while Blender is converting an inspected FBX plan?
qa_pair.answer: The export rejects before publication and requires a new inspection fingerprint.

qa_pair.question: How are excluded ancestors handled during selected-node export?
qa_pair.answer: They become temporary transform-only shells so world transforms survive without exporting ancestor mesh geometry.
